gaps: own_history is a TRAILING P/E on the ADR at calendar year-end closes (gather_numbers note), not a forward P/E; FX rates for 2021-2024 in that note are approximate and unsourced; intra-year lows/highs are missing.
No named competitor has an evidenced forward P/E in field.json (INTC loss-making on GAAP; Samsung, SMIC, UMC, GFS not retrieved): peers left out.
No attributed consensus EPS (auto.json consensus empty): the forward EPS path is the engine's from the core drivers only.

Incremental ROIC 0.61 (3y) and ROIC 0.53 come from the engine's forensic screen on companyfacts (invested capital = equity + debt - cash; TSM's large cash pile lifts it); the ROIC of the overseas fabs (Arizona, Kumamoto, Dresden) is not disclosed separately, so the base haircut is a judgement anchored on the management's ~2-3 pt gross margin dilution.
Wafer price increases from 2027 (fd_b_pricing) are a press-reported bottleneck reading, not citable: they move no number in the bull.

Bear ROIC 0.40 = the FY2023 trough ROIC 0.453 (prefetch/forensic.json) x (42.6% - 4 pts guided overseas dilution) / 42.6%; tool-price inflation on 2026-2028 capex is not sized. The forensic invested capital uses the companyfacts debt line, which looks understated (bonds payable alone NT$992bn at 2025-12-31, 6-K nm_fs_20260814), so the record ROIC may be a few points lower than shown.
